rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 2009).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2009 as 'Giggles'.
rows.Bloom: Cherry-red, silver(y) reverse. Small, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
